name: Thine Curse of Loss
source:
1928. Three years after the end of the Great War, a celebrated lieutenant colonel is sent to a high security prison island not as a guest but as a prisoner, framed by political enemies for a crime that she did not commit.

She is a war hero; she is a madwoman haunted by a ghost; and she seeks a cursed treasure hidden on that very island.

Her deadline: one year. 

[From [url=https://4noki.itch.io/thine-curse-of-loss]itch.io[/url]]
